variants.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE extremely minimal photorealistic laptop mockup for Project Koe, landscape 4:3.
Reference image is the exact composition reference: a single open slim aluminum laptop, front-left three-quarter camera angle, laptop base extending toward lower left, screen angled back and facing camera, resting on broad parallel softly rounded fluted ridges. Match this pleasing perspective and scale. Completely replace the orange palette and all Neuron website content.
Strict monochrome Koe brand palette: seamless matte pale mint/celadon #A6D6D1 studio wall, matching mint fluted platform, mint-tinted soft lighting and realistic contact shadows. Laptop silver aluminum, charcoal keyboard and black thin screen bezel. Keep premium physically realistic materials and subtle natural tonal shading. No contrasting orange, no other objects.
Laptop display is a perfectly flat, empty very pale mint background #DCEDE7. The ONLY screen content is a small, centered dark charcoal Japanese '声' logo with the word 'Koe' directly below in clean restrained modern sans serif. Exact text: '声' and 'Koe'. Together occupy only about 15 percent of screen width, centered with abundant blank space. No circle around logo, no icons, no browser chrome, no menu, no nav, no tagline, no waveform, no mascot, no image, no interface, no cursor.
Nothing outside laptop except matching mint background and the simple fluted support surface already in reference. No typography or watermark anywhere outside the laptop. Single laptop only. Absolutely minimal. Render edge-to-edge as one beautiful finished 4:3 mockup image with laptop entirely visible, useful empty space above and realistic clean soft shadows.

Use case: precise-object-edit / minimal laptop product mockup.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the finished mint Koe laptop mockup. Image 2 is the mascot identity reference.
Change ONLY the content inside the laptop display. Preserve exactly the same laptop, perspective, position, size, mint fluted platform, mint studio background, lighting, shadows, image dimensions and crop from Image 1.
Remove BOTH the Japanese logo and the word Koe from the screen. Replace them with ONLY a centered small-to-medium Kami face portrait derived faithfully from Image 2: pale mint straight long hair and bangs, brown anime eyes, gentle expression, original Koe anime appearance. Show her head and a tiny hint of the white Chinese-collar shirt at the base, no hands or full body. Her portrait should occupy about 30 percent of display height and be centered, with abundant empty space all around. Remove the charcoal background of Image 2; her face and hair must sit cleanly on the SAME flat pale mint screen background from Image 1, no visible square, no circle, no border, no frame, no card and no shadow behind the portrait. Preserve the original recognizable face and hair shape; do not turn her into a realistic human.
Nothing else on the screen. NO logo, NO name, NO text whatsoever, NO interface, NO waveform, NO call controls, NO browser chrome. Nothing added outside the screen. Only the laptop and minimal centered mascot face against the existing monochrome mint scene. Keep every pixel of the overall composition as close to Image 1 as possible. One finished landscape 4:3 image.
